summary: Lufax Holding Ltd filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its November 2026 Monthly Return to the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited, covering movements in securities for the equity issuer and Hong Kong depositary receipts under Chapter 19B. The exhibit is a standard post-month-end HKEX disclosure of issued shares and any option or award movements; no transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory term is stated. Signed by CFO Jia Liu on November 5, 2026. Not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle to monitor.
